$comment: a wrong token (or a non-auth first frame, or unparseable JSON with id null) replies 'authentication required'.
After the reply the server closes the connection (rpc.rs :: serve_tcp_connection returns while unauthenticated),
so a client must treat this as terminal for the connection, never as a retryable per-call error.
Note: a second auth frame on an already-authenticated connection replies
{"ok":false,"error":"already authenticated"} and the connection keeps serving (repeat_auth_reply).
